def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def solve(inp):
    bg=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    allc={c:comp_cells(inp,c) for c in set(v for r in inp for v in r)-{bg}}
    # stroke: color with a single 1-wide L comp? use: color whose comp count==1 and is largest single comp? 
    # demos: dst color has exactly 1 comp
    dst=[c for c,cl in allc.items() if len(cl)==1]
    # among single-comp colors pick the L-stroke (max cells, 1-wide)
    dst=max(dst,key=lambda c:len(allc[c][0]))
    stroke=allc[dst][0]
    groups={}
    for c,cl in allc.items():
        if c==dst: continue
        for comp in cl: groups.setdefault(norm(comp),[]).append(comp)
    cands=[(len(sh),lst) for sh,lst in groups.items() if len(lst)>1]
    n,lst=max(cands)
    assert sum(1 for m,_ in cands if m==n)==1
    def dist(comp): return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in comp for y2,x2 in stroke)
    tgt=max(lst,key=dist)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for y,x in tgt: out[y][x]=dst
    return out

for i,pr in enumerate(allpairs):
    pred=solve(pr['input'])
    print('pair',i,'OK' if pred==pr['output'] else 'FAIL')

def solve2(inp):
    bg=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    allc={c:comp_cells(inp,c) for c in set(v for r in inp for v in r)-{bg}}
    singles=[(len(cl[0]),c) for c,cl in allc.items() if len(cl)==1 and not has2x2(cl[0])]
    dst=max(singles)[1]; stroke=allc[dst][0]
    ys=[y for y,x in stroke]; xs=[x for y,x in stroke]
    y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    sset=set(stroke)
    inside=[comp for c,cl in allc.items() if c!=dst for comp in cl
            if all(y0<=y<=y1 and x0<=x<=x1 for y,x in comp) and not (set(comp)&sset)]
    assert len(inside)==1, inside
    inner=inside[0]; sh=norm(inner)
    groups={}
    for c,cl in allc.items():

    twins=[m for m in groups[sh] if m!=inner]
    assert len(twins)==1
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for y,x in twins[0]: out[y][x]=dst
    return out

from collections import Counter

def comps(grid, color):
    """8-connected components of a color as sets of (y,x)."""
    seen=set(comp for comp in [])
    cells=[(y,x) for y,r in enumerate(grid) for x,v in enumerate(r) if v==color]
    out=[]
    while cells:
        s=[cells.pop()]
        cl=set(s)
        while s:
            y,x=s.pop()
            for dy in (-1,0,1):
                for dx in (-1,0,1):
                    p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if p in cells:
                        cells.remove(p); cl.add(p); s.append(p)
        out.append(cl)
    return out

def norm_shape(comp):
    """Translation-invariant frozenset shape of a component."""
    y0=min(y for y,x in comp); x0=min(x for y,x in comp)
    return frozenset((y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in comp)

def has_2x2(comp):
    """True if the component contains a filled 2x2 block."""
    s=set(comp)
    return any((y,x) in s and (y,x+1) in s and (y+1,x) in s and (y+1,x+1) in s for y,x in s)

def background(grid):
    """Most common color."""
    return Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

def l_stroke(grid, bg=None):
    """The stroke: largest 2x2-free component; returns (color, cells set)."""
    bg=bg if bg is not None else background(grid)
    cc={}
    for c in set(v for r in grid for v in r)-{bg}:

    best=max((comp for cl in cc.values() for comp in cl if not has_2x2(comp)), key=len)
    return grid[next(iter(best))[0]][next(iter(best))[1]], set(best)

def concave_twin_recolor(grid, bg=None):
    """Recolor to the L-stroke color the shape-twin of the component nested in the L's concave corner."""
    bg=bg if bg is not None else background(grid)
